name: Log Fires
summary: Bring a cozy fireplace right into your living room.

name: Feride
summary: This edgy and unique Turkish animated series follows the fiercely independent Feride as she struggles to maintain optimism amid the monotony of life.

name: Jasmine
summary: Jasmine works as an escort to provide a better life for her and her stepbrother Tufan – and bribe her way onto the heart transplant list.

name: Pamaal
summary: The story follows Malika, a woman who leaves her traditional family life for love, only to find herself trapped in a marriage with Raza, who becomes increasingly possessive and emotionally abusive.

name: The RVers
summary: Members of the RV community provide an informative look at the lifestyle.

name: The Sneaker Boom
summary: Explores how young NBA stars and marketing execs drove an explosion in global popularity in sneakers in the 1990s.

name: Fred et son orchestre
summary: Fred Marsac built his life around jazz. He was happy with his family, alongside his wife and two children, Estelle and Sam. When his wife died in a car accident, he disappeared. He entrusted Sam and Estelle to his in-laws, only to reappear four years later. The welcome is frosty. Estelle rejects him, and his in-laws resent him. To redeem himself, Fred accepts a position as a music teacher at a middle school. The principal, Isabelle Martinet, reluctant to integrate him into the teaching staff, assigns him the most difficult class.

name: Love Through a Prism
summary: When a textbook painter meets an eccentric genius at a famed art academy in 1900s London, a fierce rivalry ignites and romance blossoms off the canvas.

name: Hamburg Days
summary: Based on the autobiography by Klaus Voormann, Hamburg Days is set in the early 1960s. In the smoke-filled clubs of Hamburg's St. Pauli's red-light district, an inexperienced young rock ‘n' roll band from Liverpool collide with two young artists, Klaus Voormann and Astrid Kirchherr. Together they help spark a transformation that turns a scrappy group of teenagers into the greatest music phenomenon the world has ever known: The Beatles.

name: Winter
summary:
Dr Ethan Winter is one of the most gifted pathologists of his generation. He possesses an extraordinary analytical mind, capable of impeccable deductive reasoning which perfectly complements DI Lauren Bell, a meticulous, no-nonsense detective who is as driven as Winter when working on a case. Together they make a formidable team, as Winter's genius and insight into the victims is invaluable to Bell and her murder squad detectives.

Yet Winter is harbouring a secret. The unsolved murder of someone close to him still haunts his every move, and he's intent on unofficially investigating the death to bring the murderer to justice.

name: The Heat
summary:
The Heat sees ten ambitious chefs travel to Barcelona, working under multi Michelin Star award-winning chef Jean-Christophe Novelli, who is opening an exclusive summer restaurant at the glamorous Port Vell Marina and on a mission to find the next rising star.

But this isn't just a straight-forward cooking competition - each day when the kitchen service is over, the cameras keep rolling because when you're living, working and competing with one another, there is no escaping The Heat. Viewers can expect post shift dates, staff nights out and more - blending both their professional and personal lives will see tempers simmer, steam and boil, in and outside of the kitchen. 

These young hopefuls will quickly realise that no-one's place is secure in this fierce culinary contest, as they consistently battle it out in a bid to climb the kitchen ranks. Promotions, demotions, power plays, sackings and shock decisions throughout the series are sure to keep the contenders on their toes - every service is a chance to soar or sink.

name: Debbie Macomber's Mrs. Miracle
summary: A mysterious housekeeper named Mrs. Miracle gently uses a touch of Christmas magic to heal hearts, mend families, and bring love and hope back into people's lives.

name: Little Fucker
summary:
Twelve-year-old Shay, an outcast in his family and at school, discovers his father Yaki's secret affair and begins blackmailing him, turning the family dynamics upside down. Yaki, a self-absorbed aspiring author, scrambles to protect his secret while Shay revels in his newfound power. Their escalating feud takes a dark turn when Shay enlists the help of a sinister neighbor who happens to also be the local pedophile, and Yaki involves an ex-detective to unmask the blackmailer.

 

As their schemes spiral out of control, the fractured family faces trying consequences, culminating in a desperate father-son alliance to save their youngest sibling and salvage what's left of their lives.

name: Родная
summary: Parents Anna and Sergey discover they're raising someone else's child: seven years ago, during IVF, doctors switched the embryos of two women. Anna decides to learn more about her biological daughter, who lives with another family.

name: Брошенная невеста
summary: Ambitious and goal-oriented Sofia Likhacheva is used to keeping everything under control. She works as a crime reporter and enjoys conducting her own investigations. Sonya's personal life is also going well. Her fiancé Nikolai is a major businessman, the owner of a construction company, and they are scheduled to get married very soon. But Nikolai suddenly calls off the wedding and announces that he has met the woman of his dreams. This chance meeting with nurse Victoria seems suspicious to Likhacheva, but the fiancé does not want to hear that the meeting was set up and that his new acquaintance is after his money. Then Sofia decides to find out more about her rival, and during the investigation she learns suspicious facts from Vika's past.

name: Роковой мужчина
summary: A woman is found murdered in the home of a notorious womanizer, restaurateur Lebedev. The investigation is led by Kira Avdeeva, who has a score of her own to settle with the womanizers: her lover just dumped her, publicly insulting her as they parted. It seems obvious that Lebedev is the culprit. But it soon emerges that his son disappeared on the evening of the murder. As Kira unravels the case, she realizes it is directly related to her own personal tragedy...

name: Враги
summary: In Belouralsk, a grandiose construction project for a chemical plant and a satellite city has been announced. The city's power is divided between the local crime boss, Uma, and the corrupt head of the criminal investigation department, Mamonov. As the city undergoes significant changes, they engage in a criminal war, each seeking to gain full control over the construction and its billions of dollars in funding.

name: Я отменяю смерть
summary: Rita inherited an old bracelet from her mother, which simply fell from the hand of a dead woman, but during her lifetime she never took it off. The girl put on the bracelet and realized that now she can hear the voices of the dead, or rather, their cries for help, and also move in time, just for a day, but this is enough for her to have time to prevent someone's death. Rita quickly realizes that the bracelet cannot be removed and there is no escape from the strange gift. Then she gets a job at the morgue to be closer to those who need her help.

name: Does It Count If You Lose Your Innocence to an Android?
summary: Office Lady Tsuda Akane, age 28, seems like she's got it all together. Beautiful, brainy, and an indispensable office worker for a robotics manufacturer, Akane's admired at work...because her colleagues can't see her at home. Privately, Akane's a hot mess with an apartment that looks more like a landfill than a living space. Good thing she drunkenly ordered a new android named Nadeshiko to help her clean up! Well, maybe not good, because the beautiful lady android that arrives is a horny hottie. Akane's about to get more service than she expected!

previousepisode.name: Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka?? Special

name: Terra alta
summary: Terra Alta is a place of wild beauty, where the scars of the Civil War still bleed. A peaceful territory until the brutal murder of Francisco and Rosa Adell, patriarchs of the wealthiest and most powerful family in the area, shocks everyone. This event forces Melchor Marín, one of the agents in charge of the investigation, to relive his dark, complex, and forgotten past. Politics, ambition, family, money, sex, religion, history…and revenge. A crime that will change the lives of everyone in Terra Alta.

name: Mina Settembre
summary: Mina Settembre is a social worker constantly searching for solutions to other people's problems. Her love life is always precarious, torn between her affection for Claudio, her ex-husband, and her passion for Domenico, a charming gynecologist. Her family is also in tatters, between a cynical and spiteful mother and a recently deceased father who kept a painful truth from her. But despite it all, Mina never loses her smile or the strength to help everyone.

name: Reborn from the Ashes
summary: On the day of her grand wedding, Wen Yueqian personally witnessed her father being wrongfully executed before her eyes. Later, on her wedding night, she walked into the bridal chamber only to find her husband in an illicit affair with another woman. When she confronted him, instead of receiving an explanation, she was brutally murdered and thrown off a cliff. Miraculously, Wen Yueqian survived the fall, and alongside her, Xiao Jin, unwilling to meet his end, was also resurrected. From that moment on, their fates became intertwined.

name: Baking Championship: Next Gen
summary: Baking Championship: Next Gen with hosts and judges, Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown. The pair of culinary experts helm the jam-packed pastry journey that will give a whole new meaning to sibling rivalry when 12 teams of siblings aged 8-14 compete to win $25,000 and become the next generation of Baking Champions. The wholesome and delightful confectionary competition will launch with a supersized two-hour qualifying round to determine who will continue across the eight subsequent episodes to clinch the prize. Once the competition begins, the sibling collaborators will take on tricky challenges like "breakfast dessert imposters," "cream puff friendship bracelets," and "animated cakes.

name: La ricetta della felicità
summary: Marta Rampini sees her perfect life fall apart when her husband Enrico, wanted for money laundering, disappears. Left alone with her daughter Greta and her mother-in-law Rosa, who suffers from Alzheimer's, Marta is forced to start her life over and, with great strength and resilience, tries to understand what happened to her husband.

name: Fuochi d'artificio
summary: Four teenagers decide to secretly help the Italian Resistance in the fight against the Nazi invaders. A great partisan adventure and a story of love and friendship, told from the point of view of thirteen-year-old Marta.

name: Le onde del passato
summary: Elba Island, summer 2004. Anna and Tamara are two young friends attending a summer music event. After the concert, invited to a party on a yacht, they are raped. Twenty years later, Tamara calls Anna and tells her she's caught one of the molesters, but when Anna arrives on the island, the man is dead. Who was it? The case is assigned to possibly an old acquaintance of Anna's, commissario Luca Bonnard, who focuses his suspicions on Tamara. But Anna fights to prove her friend's innocence, find the real killer, and find the other rapists.

name: Chris Ramsey's Alternative Christmas Guide
summary:
Hosted by British comedian Chris Ramsey, the show is all about embracing the joy of throwing a Christmas party, with minimal effort, whoever the guests happen to be… 

Across three episodes, Chris takes on the ultimate festive challenge hosting three big Christmas get-togethers. From prepping canapés to decking the halls and keeping guests entertained, he's on a mission to prove that anyone can throw a proper Christmas bash without the stress. Expect laughter, a few mishaps, and plenty of festive spirit along the way!

previousepisode.name: Chapter 3: Chris' calm and quiet boxing day dinner (not quite)

name: Stories from the Armchair
summary: Israel's favorite comedians sit on a couch and share the funniest, most embarrassing and weirdest experiences from their lives, the kind everyone at home knows all too well.

name: Primeri inspektorja Vrenka
summary: In an elite Maribor neighborhood, a cleaning lady finds the bloodied body of a prominent doctor. Although traces point to a suicide, a handful of illogical details become reason enough for Inspector Vrenko to open an investigation. It turns out that not only the neighborhood is cold and sterile, also its residents are cold and inaccessible. After the first conversations, Vrenko can't shake the feeling that all the interlocutors are hiding something and at the same time everyone is watching out for everyone.

name: VK против мошенников
summary: VK against Scammers is a new project that is bound to appear in the current reality! Fraud victim Andrei Beburishvili, professional psychotherapist Vasily Beinarovich and two anti-fraud bloggers Alexander Kharchevnikov and Ilya Blanco analyze real cases of deceived victims right in the studio, and also give viewers tips for countering scams.

name: КИБЕР ВЕЧЕР
summary: Andrey Beburishvili, German Gromov, Sergey Gorokh and Dmitry Liks communicate with esports players and just popular people who like to play games on the most interesting topics. Counter-Strike, Dota2, Valorant, LoL, The Legend of Zelda, Dark Souls, Super Mario, Resident Evil, Halo, Doom, Minecraft, The Last of Us, GTA, Twitch, Elo, MM: if you buy the meaning of these words or have ever heard them, go watch, we created it.

name: НУБ
summary: "NOOB" is a quiz in which very simple questions on the topic of video games are asked to players with different gaming experience.

previousepisode.name: #5 | Оля Парфенюк, Катя Вяликова, Саша Ваш, Амина Tenderlybae

name: The Woman in the Septic Tank 3: The Real Untold Story of Josephine Bracken
В Таверну
summary:
A role-playing board game based on the world of Dota 2. Join your favorite doters and comedians and have an adventure with them!

HF

previousepisode.name: #4 | Герман El Classico, Gromjkeee, Женат на Марине, Никита Никитин, Николай Прокофьев. В поисках Скипетра Аганима.

name: Second Chance Love
summary: In Second Chance Love, five pairs of first loves reunite for a two-week journey filled with nostalgia, emotional reflection, and intimate dates. Led by our hosts, they revisit their pasts, confront unfinished business, and rediscover what once brought them together. As they build new memories and lean on each other for support, one big question remains: will they rekindle the spark they once had or discover that love belongs in the past? Told only in the way Hallmark can, with heartfelt emotion, authentic connection, and just a touch of magic, this new, original  series is a celebration of second chances and the enduring power of love.

name: L'altro ispettore
summary: Domenico "Mimmo" Dodaro, a labor inspector known for his integrity, moves to Lucca with his daughter Mimì after the death of his wife. Hosted by Alessandro, a family friend who was paralyzed in the same accident that killed Domenico's father, they find support from their relatives. While Mimì and Alessandro try to help him rebuild his life, Domenico tackles new cases and uncovers a shocking truth about his father's death that puts him in danger.

name: Synden
summary: When teenager Silas is found dead at a farmhouse on the Bjäre peninsula – the perpetually angry, odd but highly intelligent investigator Dani is teamed up with newly graduated police colleague Malik to investigate the case. The investigation leads Dani and Malik into a patriarchal rat-hole on the Scanian countryside and they soon find themselves at the center of a dark family feud that has been going on for generations. Dani, who has a personal connection to the victim Silas, is drawn deep into the investigation and the families it centers around. The Patriarch Elis gives Dani a deadline to solve the case before taking matters into his own hands within the family. Synden is a modern crime set in an uncertain world of conflict and violence where the original sin is constantly present.

name: Быть Джиганом и Оксаной
summary: Parents with many children, rapper Dzhigan and influencer Oksana Samoilova, will let viewers into the most intimate corners of their lives and honestly tell them about the events of the past few months.

name: Наводим порядок с доктором Зубаревой
summary:
"Putting Things in Order" is a show in which Natalia Zubareva, a preventive medicine doctor, checks apartments using her unique technique to detect threats that you don't even know about.
Human health directly depends on the space that surrounds it. A house is an organism that can fail even if everything around it is shining clean.

name: Waar De F*ck Is Stuk?
summary: Giel, Thomas and Stefan disappear from the radar individually for five days, with only one goal: not to get caught. For the first time, the gentlemen themselves are the targets. Not only in the Netherlands, but across Europe's largest cities, they try to remain elusive, while six fanatical duos, aided by viewers at home, open the hunt.

name: TopKnotz
summary:
TopKnotz is an adrenaline-fuelled power trip across the waters of the South Pacific hosted by an all-star lineup including: Gold Logie winner Grant Denyer, culinary expert Miguel Maestre, professional surfer Felicity Palmateer, veteran stuntman Rob Palmer, and seasoned presenter Tom Williams.

This new series follows the five fearless hosts as they dive headfirst into the world of marine leisure, tackle extreme challenges and wild stunts, and encounter hilarious mishaps along the way.

name: Hammam
summary: A team of fighters is sent to "Hammam," a God-fearing outpost in the Jordan Valley, where a series of mysterious events shakes everyone's routine and psyche. Power relations are tested, loyalties are shattered, and above all, an ancient curse hangs over them: a forgotten biblical story that is reawakened through the soldiers.

name: Love (X)
summary: It follows 12 singles of different genders and sexualities who are looking for love without boundaries. Hosted by Jane, Timethai, Rusameekae, and Cris.

previousepisode.name: LOVE(X) Ultimate Confession Night! Love Without Boundaries, All For YOU!

name: Earth Oven with Temuera Morrison
summary: Temuera Morrison is hungry, and he's using his favourite kai as a vehicle to head off on a globe-trotting adventure. Tem will visit indigenous communities from all around the world to uncover how earth ovens have shaped their cultures.

name: Spring Fever
summary: Spring Fever: the tiredness people often feel in spring. Yun Bom, a teacher with a frozen heart, arrives at a small rural school and slowly rediscovers joy through Seon Jae Gyu's warmth.

name: Hidden Treasures
summary: Ms. Liang Qing Yan and Song Yuan Ye star in a secret love rescue story that spans five years. The "whimsical" childhood friend Song Yuan Ye, despite appearing slovenly, actually accompanies Liang Qing Yan with deep affection. After Liang Qing Yan loses his memory, he secretly unravels a conspiracy, making the two become closer again in the midst of crises, with a mutual emotional tension that is irresistible.

name: The Traitors: New Blood
summary:
Season 5 of The Traitors https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/58177/the-traitors

The Traitors: New Blood is NBC's civilian version of Peacock's Emmy Award-winning competition reality series, The Traitors, known for strategic gameplay and skillful saboteurs.

name: Научный спорт
summary:
"Scientific Sport" is a new show in which Alexander Pushnoy and Nikita Nagorny will analyze sports from the point of view of science.
In each episode, the hosts, along with sports stars, conduct spectacular experiments and test unusual hypotheses to answer the most interesting questions. How to lose weight with the help of the brain? Who is stronger left-handed or right-handed? What is the most dangerous shot in sports? You will see all this in the Science Sports show!

name: Спортивные тайны
summary:
"Sports Secrets" is a show in which Alexey Stolyarov penetrates into the hidden corners of the sports industry to uncover the most unusual secrets and conspiracies of world sports.
Do you want to find out how the state of the sheikhs is changing the sports industry, what is behind the broken careers of champions, how multimillion-dollar transfers are arranged and why the salaries of stars reach astronomical amounts?

previousepisode.name: #6 | Зарплаты, которые шокируют. Почему спортсмены получают целые состояния

name: De Kluis: Het Masterplan
summary: Six well-known Dutch celebrities embark on the biggest heist of their lives. Led by mastermind Daan Schuurmans, they attempt to rob a heavily secured bank. But Team Stuk will do everything in its power to stop them. The robbers have 48 hours to steal as much gold as possible. But no one can be trusted: even within their own team, they could be robbed.

name: Выжить за 36 часов с Эдом Халиловым
summary: A travel experiment in which five stars must escape the Vietnamese jungle and return to civilization in 36 hours. Hosted by seasoned survivalist Ed Khalilov.

name: Noční operatér
summary: Renowned cardiac surgeon MUDr. Hart's life falls apart after the police believe he is a wanted serial killer known as the Night Operator. In a race against time and under pressure from the sensationalist media, his only chance to prove his innocence is to return to the operating room.

name: Darna
summary: Narda takes on the responsibility to protect a powerful stone after her superhero mother's death. When a green crystal transforms civilians into monsters, she uses all her might to save the day.

name: In the Clear Moonlit Dusk
summary: Yoi Takiguchi has long legs, a deep voice, and a handsome face…in other words, Yoi is such a good-looking guy that most people don't notice or care that she is, in fact, a girl. Indeed, she's had the nickname "Prince" as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai…the only person who's really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she's not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

name: Повернення
summary:
The Return is the first Ukrainian series about a veteran of the Russian-Ukrainian war, created in close collaboration with veterans. After suffering a serious injury, professional soldier Oleksandr Krechet can no longer return to the front lines and is forced to find his place in civilian life.
After regaining consciousness following an amputation, Oleksandr faces not only physical pain, but also inner demons — the image of his fallen comrade Serhiy Verba appears in his mind. Krechet tries to support his friend's family, help his wife and son cope with their loss and withstand new trials. Through the power of friendship, the absurd situations of civilian life, and the gradual acceptance of his new self, the hero embarks on a journey of true return — home and to his own identity.

name: See No Evil
summary: See No Evil is a forensic look at the biggest scandal in Church of England history. Featuring never-seen-before interviews, this two-part series explores the psychology of a prolific abuser and tells the inside story of John Smyth's sinister world, through exclusive and intimate testimony from his children and widow.

name: A Little Bit of Stand Up To Cancer
summary: Dermot Murnaghan launches the nightly update for Stand Up To Cancer 2025's week of fundraising action. Expect headline-grabbing celebrity stunts, powerful stories already grabbing the headlines and an unmissable look at what's still to come.

name: First Dates Beach Club
summary: First Dates takes its matchmaking magic to Spain, as Fréd Sirieix welcomes a fresh influx of hopeful - but sometimes hopeless - singles to a stunning beachside setting. This isn't just dinner, drinks and done; it's cocktails by the pool and sangria on the sand, with sparks flying in all directions. Anything is possible when romance meets holiday bliss and endless sunshine.

name: The Year From Space
summary: The biggest stories of the year told through awe-inspiring satellite images, revealing some of the secrets behind the headlines - from national elections to extreme weather and a solar eclipse.

name: Broken Arrows: The Lost Bombs of the Cold War
Drugs van de Duivel
summary: Dutch criminals have flocked to the lucrative meth business, working closely with Mexican drug cartels. Crime reporter John van den Heuvel investigates the rise of crystal meth in the Netherlands. He speaks with dealers, users, drug cooks, and law enforcement officials.

name: Long Shen Wan Xiang: Long Hun
Xbox Bowl
summary: The Xbox Bowl is an American NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision (FBS) college football bowl game played at Ford Center at The Star in Frisco, Texas, to first be played in December 2025. Owned by ESPN Events, the bowl has tie-ins with Conference USA and the Sun Belt Conference. On December 4, 2025, the Xbox Bowl was announced as the replacement for the Bahamas Bowl.

previousepisode.name: Missouri State Bears vs. Arkansas State Red Wolves

name: Aaron Hernandez - An ID Murder Mystery
summary: This absorbing true-crime series takes a fresh look at shocking and well-publicized mysteries -- with exclusive interviews, recent developments, and critical updates coming together to produce inspired new theories in the search for truth and justice.

name: ABC Monsters
summary: They are big, hairy and not very scary. The ABC Monsters are on the loose and only Alice Brian and Cherry Berry can catch them. Twenty Six cuddly ABC Monsters live within the walls of Capital Castle. Each monster represents a letter of the alphabet, but should any of the monsters go missing for longer than a day, all the letters will be wiped clean from every book in Capital Town, so it's very important to make sure that all the ABC Monsters colorare safely back in Alphabet Gardens before the sun goes down. However, this isn't as easy as it sounds. The ABC Monsters are wonderfully curious and happy creatures and often wonder off from the Alphabet Gardens to try new and fun things, invariably getting themselves lost in the process.

name: Zero Star: The Cam Ward Story
summary: Witness Cam Ward's unlikely rise from overlooked high school QB with one Division FCS offer to the NFL draft's no. 1 pick. Narrated by Warren Moon.

name: StandUp. Пародии
summary:
StandUp. Parodies are a show in which
professional comedians try on the images of stars and show how their stand-up could look like.

name: СОВЕРШЕННО ДЕКРЕТНО
summary: A completely maternity podcast where Yasya 13 talks about her pregnancy, childbirth and motherhood.

name: The Secret of Girls
summary: Xu Jingxi quits her city job and sets out to Dali, Yunnan, to live her final days without regret. Losing her wallet upon arrival, she turns to Wen Shan, a quiet employee at the guesthouse, and works there to repay her debt. As the carefree Jingxi and reserved Wen Shan share daily life under the Dali sky, they gradually open up, finding warmth, healing, and love in each other's company - a tender story of courage and connection between two women.

name: Broken (of) Love
summary: A woman betrayed by her fiancée and returning not for healing but to "finish what was started"

name: Похищенная
summary: Kristina Malakhova, an environmental expert, is in the process of divorcing her husband, Yakov, whom she suspects of infidelity. One day, Kristina arrives in the town of Drevlyansk to conduct an environmental assessment and gets into a conflict with a local developer. This story is captured on local television, and soon a stranger, Svetlana Kalinina, approaches Kristina. She claims that Kristina is her daughter, kidnapped thirty years ago! The heroine begins her own investigation. Her attempts to uncover her true past lead to a series of deaths.

name: Ravu Jôtô
summary: In Japan's first dating show for rebellious yankiis, 11 singles butt heads, forge bonds and live together for 14 days as they go all out to find the one.

name: Single Papa
summary: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

name: Трое в лабиринте
summary: Regina decided to tell her businessman husband, Vadim. She'd met another man and expected this new misfortune to bring the same warmth that had faded over the years in her family. The biggest problem was her daughter, Anya. The teenage girl didn't want to hear about her parents' divorce. Vadim insisted that his daughter stay with him because Regina would soon come to her senses and return home. Then Regina took a desperate step: she confessed that she had Anya by another man. She hadn't confessed to Vadim about her infidelity, and he had raised someone else's daughter. To Regina's surprise, Vadim said he'd always known about it. Thinking he simply didn't believe her, she threatened to have a genetic test. Vadim advised her against it: she didn't like the results. "He was right," he shocked Regina. Vadim really wasn't the girl's father. But if only that... To uncover the secret of her own daughter's birth, Regina had to look at the past differently.

name: Only You
summary: Despite her mother's protests, Jillian pursues her dream of becoming a chef by joining a cooking contest where she gets a chance to study culinary arts in different Asian countries. Before anyone can stop her, she is already on her way to South Korea with her long-time best friend, Jonathan. But it soon becomes clear to her that skill alone is not enough to make her pass such a difficult course. So in her desperate attempt to succeed and create a good life for her family, she goes in search for a woman who can teach her a winning recipe.

name: Teach Me
summary: Teach Me centers on a teacher wielding power over an impressionable but unreliable student, chronicling what happens when that student becomes the teacher as an exploration of the blurred lines between sex, power and addiction.

name: La linea della Palma
summary: The troubled journalist Anna Romano investigates the theft of a famous Caravaggio painting trying to uncover the truth about her father's mysterious disappearance. Drawn into the world of art trading, amidst financial intrigue and shady dealings with the mafia, she soon realizes that her family is hiding dangerous secrets.

name: Random Alliance
summary: Set 30 years in the future, San Country has fallen under the control of AI. A group of young people determined to take charge of their own destinies forms the Random Alliance and launches a real-time confrontation against the AI, Zero.Eventually, by integrating the ancient wisdom of the I Ching, the Random Alliance defeats Zero with a universal random formula. They rectify Zero's upgrade trajectory, ushering in an era of harmonious coexistence between humanity and artificial intelligence.

name: Under the Surface
summary: They are the closest of friends, but a single mishap plunges them into a bloody path. At the instigation of a down-and-out heiress, an innocent girl disguises herself as the idealized first love of a social-climbing man to uncover the truth behind her lover's death. This time, they are determined to reclaim everything that is rightfully theirs！

name: The Royal Highness of the Princess
summary: When C-list actor An Ran accidentally transmigrates into a script, she plays the fool to find her way back to the modern world. Her attempt to save a minor character, however, pulls her into the revenge plot of Yu Wenrui, a scheming chief minister. Now posing as the minister's loyal lackey, An Ran must navigate a partnership built on mutual deception, all while a conspiracy to overthrow the Yunmi Empire unfolds around them...

name: Rooster
summary: Rooster follows a middle aged author navigating a complicated relationship with his daughter.

name: Incas: The Rise and Fall
summary: The rise and fall of the Inca is a story of a civilization marked by gold, power and ingenuity. From monumental cities and vast empires stretching across the Andes to dazzling treasures that inspired legends, the Incas conquered millions and reshaped South America. But their golden age ended suddenly, leaving behind mysteries, monumental ruins, and a legacy that still captivates the world.

name: Vals Spel
summary: Ten candidates, one power game. No clue, no explanation. A strategic game at the highest level. It's not fair, it's Vals Spel! Arno Kantelberg, Défano Holwijn, Dionne Slagter, Juultje Tieleman, Marouane Meftah, Maxim Hartman, Margriet van der Linden, Teun Kapitein, Victoria Koblenko, and Vonneke Bonneke take on the most strategic challenge of their lives.

name: De Hanslers: van de Piste naar de Playa
summary: Mike and Monique from Winter Vol Liefde are embarking on a new adventure in Spain. In this reality series, they open a beach club on the Costa Blanca, full of sun, drama, and family issues.

name: Het zwaard van Damocles
summary: This psychological reality show is all about power, manipulation, strategy, and trust. Thirteen celebrities compete for €500,000, and in each episode, the group votes someone out.

name: The Festive Finish Line
summary: Roman Kemp hosts five festive episodes of the quiz, assisted by Sarah Greene. In each show, five celebrities race in moving podiums race across a Christmas-themed studio.

name: Heimwee naar Schokland
summary: Huub Stapel visits the former island of Schokland, where he and writer and historian Eva Vriend unravel the impressive and moving story of the Schokkers.

name: Pojken i Grannhuset
summary: Journalist Linnéa Krook recognizes her childhood crush Anton on TV and decides to find out why he disappeared 20 years ago. As Linnéa starts digging into the past, more and more questions arise. Why did he prefer playing horse with 12-year-old Linnéa rather than spending time with Linnéa's 17-year old older sister, his girlfriend of the same age? And why did he write passionate love poems in Linnéa's friendship book? The series follows both Linnéa's search for the truth and Anton's own struggle as being attracted to minors.

name: Huwag Ka Lang Mawawala
summary: A strong woman and a loving daughter who would do everything for the sake of her family. Amidst all the trials that she is facing, Anessa will fall in love with Eros, a rich young man who will turn her life into a nightmare.

name: Opgelicht In De Liefde?
summary: Ellie Lust and her team confront fraudsters who have not only broken the hearts of their loved ones, but also left them penniless. The police and judicial authorities can do little or nothing about this devious behavior, because in most cases no criminal offense has been committed.

name: Scam Alert: Trap Er Niet In!
summary: Ellie Lust and cyberjournalist Daniël Verlaan delve into the dark world of online scams. How are people hacked, scammed, and even exposed online when their most personal information is made public? Ellie highlights urgent issues and the stories of victims, while Daniël and his team of ethical hackers thoroughly investigate the scams.

name: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle
summary: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

previousepisode.name: Jason Priestly, Magnus Ferrell, Joe Santagato

nextepisode.name: Amanda Peet, Chef Rasheeda Purdie, Jonathan Haidt, Catherine Price, Kashus Culpepper

name: Unfamiliar
summary: Hidden in the heart of Berlin, ex-spies Simon and Meret run a safe house. When a threat they thought was buried reappears, they find themselves hiding from assassins, Russian agents, the BND, ex-lovers and a whole bunch of people they have wronged - all while trying to keep their marriage together.

name: Maxxed Out
summary: Maxxed Out reveals how money (and mismanaged money) can strain even the strongest relationships. Each episode uncovers the "What were you thinking?" moments behind financial disasters and the tough love it takes to turn things around.

name: Storm & Alexis
summary: Two of 5's much-loved faces team up to focus on the issues that matter most to viewers - with your opinions front and centre.

name: Matt Allwright
summary: Matt looks at the big news stories developing during the day and offers help and advice to save you money and make your lives a little easier.

name: How I Got My Trainer to be My Boyfriend
summary: Photsawat is a former famous boxing champion who was forced to leave the sport after being accused of throwing a match and, to make matters worse, his ex-wife ran off with all his hard-earned savings. Now living hand to mouth, he works as a motorcycle taxi driver to support his daughter. By chance, he meets Homerun, a young man who once suffered from depression because of his difficult past. Inspired by Photsawat, Homerun manages to turn his life around and make a fresh start. He asks Photsawat to become his boxing coach so that he can pursue his dream of becoming a champion. However, his true goal is not only to win in the ring, but also to win his coach's heart.

name: Nordin
summary: When luxury-loving Nordin Kynani is forced by his mother to spend a year teaching at an underprivileged school, he expects an easy ride. But between rebellious students, a corrupt principal, and his own ego, he soon learns that real life isn't about fast cars, but about making an impact. Can he turn himself and his class into a success story, or will he fail spectacularly?

name: To Kill a Dictator
summary: Assassinations, even of the most treacherous dictator, can shake a nation's confidence, launch wars, or end them. Now, we go behind closed doors to meet the rebels, revolutionaries, and intelligence operatives tasked with these takedowns.

name: Drömdag
summary: Martin Sleipnes, Morten Ramm og Vegar Tryggeseid reiser rundt for å gi folk en drømmedag av dimensjoner.

name: Baemon House
summary: The very first behind-the-scenes look at the newly, but upcoming K-POP Group BABYMONSTER that shows their everyday life, providing a warm and lively glimpse into their home and personalities.

name: Berlín y la dama del armiño
summary: Targeting a priceless work of art, Berlin assembles his gang of thieves in Seville in this explosive new installment from the creators of Money Heist.

previousepisode.name: La felicidad es del que ama

name: Finding Her Edge
summary: The series follows the three Russo sisters, heirs to a struggling figure skating dynasty. As middle sister, seventeen-year-old Adriana trains for the World Championships with new partner Brayden, while still harbouring feelings for her first love and former partner, Freddie. Her life becomes complicated when she and Brayden pretend to be a couple off the ice so they can land a sponsorship to keep the financially struggling Russo rink afloat.

name: The CEO Club
summary: Seven ambitious and extraordinary women open their lives and businesses to reveal what it really takes to build empires, balance family, and navigate friendship at the highest level-where each and every move is personal, powerful, and under the spotlight.

name: Old Street Justice
summary: In 1995, after returning to his hometown, Zhao Fengsheng is shunned by old neighbors over a misunderstanding. To clear his name, he leads the "Four Troublemakers of Old Street" to dismantle a sinister conspiracy, resolve old grudges, and ultimately protect the peace of his homeland.

name: Her Radiance
summary: Medical student Jiang Yuanyue, in search of her missing elder sister Jiang Shuwan, assumes the alias Yan Ran and deliberately approaches Zeng Yuankai, the second young master of the Zeng family. Successfully infiltrating the household by posing as Yuankai's maid, Yan Ran continues her investigation and ultimately discovers her sister's body buried in the abandoned courtyard of the Zeng estate. She comes to suspect that the culprits may be the two Zeng brothers. Following the mysterious death of Chen Shulin, Yan Ran and Zeng Yuankai gradually uncover the true, ruthless nature of the Zeng family patriarch Zeng Shaozong. They expose his past crimes, including the deaths of Jiang Yunwen and Gu Manqing, Zeng Yuankai's biological mother, and the devastating truth that Zeng Shaozong is not Yuankai's real father.

name: Elegy of ZhaoLi
summary: Jiang Li, daughter of the Grand Tutor, often retreats to the secluded Wenxiang Pavilion with her confidante, A Zhao, to avoid an arranged marriage. Forced into a marriage with the Left General, she enters the palace, only to discover that A Zhao is the reigning emperor. From then on, they are deeply entangled in love and palace secrets.

name: Romance in the Lie
summary: Rebelling against her father's arranged marriage, independent woman Aurel gets drunk and mistakes the billionaire Ray for a male escort, claiming to want to pay for his services. When she finds out he is her childhood sweetheart, the line between truth and falsehood is blurred. Their relationship arouses suspicion within Aurel's family, setting the stage for a family feud...

name: Lao Zu De Lao Gong Jing Shi Xiao Jiao Fu
Best of the World with Antoni Porowski
summary:
National Geographic announced today the greenlight of Best of the World with Antoni Porowski, a vibrant new travel docuseries set to premiere in 2026 on National Geographic, Disney+ and Hulu. Inspired by National Geographic's annual Best of the World list of travel recommendations and bestselling book, the four-part series follows Emmy®-winner and New York Times bestselling author Antoni Porowski on a deeply personal journey through Paris, Mexico City, London and New York City.

Bringing his signature curiosity, humor and refined taste, Porowski takes the Best of the World list one step further to explore food, places to stay, wellness and hidden corners of each city. He plunges into unforgettable moments: learning the delicate precision of Paris' most hyper-local and inventive Michelin-starred restaurant, paddling through centuries-old canals in Mexico City, and connecting with locals whose stories define what makes each city truly shine. Using National Geographic's signature cinematography and storytelling expertise, the series brings each city to life with the authenticity and visual richness the brand is known for. Each episode presents a mosaic of accessible yet aspirational moments that reflect the diversity, creativity, and emerging trends shaping each city today.

name: Astronauta
summary: HBO presents this series that follows Mauricio de Sousa's famous character as an adult, ready for his most dangerous adventure.

name: Badgast
summary: Vince arrives on Terschelling with his daughter Zoë for what seems like an innocent father-daughter vacation. The summer that was supposed to bring them closer takes a different turn on Terschelling. Behind his smile lies a secret: he's come to Terschelling with a mission.

name: Le calendrier de l'avent
summary: In this reality TV show with the feel of a Christmas tale, Katherine Levac gives a charming single woman 24 days to find love.

name: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch
summary: Spica Virgo is an apprentice witch, but can't use any magic. She needs someone to be her master in order to get into the academy of her dreams, but she has no money and no connections. Suddenly, a mysterious talking black cat that can use magic appears before her!! Spica wants to learn magic, and the black cat wants his curse broken—goals on the same path. Therefore, a secret master-apprentice relationship was born! But the key to breaking the curse is kissing his…?!

name: Suddenly Amish
summary: Suddenly Amish follows six non-Amish individuals on a rare journey as they leave behind their modern "English" lifestyle and step into a deeply traditional Amish community in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. Seeking a profound change from their present way of modern life, each participant contemplates the possibility of converting into Amish society, as they navigate drastically different routines and a culture defined by faith, discipline, simplicity and community.

name: Buongiorno, Mamma!
summary: A wonderful family tale that encompasses both joyous and sorrowful moments, intertwining the past and present, while also delving into the realms of mystery and truth.

name: True Luna
summary: When Emma Parker turns 18, she learns that Logan Carter, the alpha of her pack, is her future mate. But her happiness is short-lived when Logan rejects her for another she-wolf.

name: Omer et le Fils de l'Etoile
Villains
summary: A bloody confrontation takes place between villains over super-notes, which is a counterfeit bill of extreme high quality.

name: Der Mordanschlag
summary: The Assassination Attempt is a German two-part television film by Miguel Alexandre from 2018. Petra Schmidt-Schaller and Ulrich Tukur can be seen in the leading roles. The political thriller is based on real events around the RAF murders of Alfred Herrhausen and Detlev Rohwedder as well as the events in Bad Kleinen and is based on the novel The Last Terrorist by André Georgi.

name: Skinny Dip
summary: Skinny Dip is the story of Joey Perrone, whose second anniversary didn't go quite as planned. She expected earrings, but instead, her husband Chaz had, shall we say, alternate plans. After unexpectedly finding herself on the other side of those plans, she vows to get revenge. Teaming up with a disgraced ex-cop, Joey sets out to make Chaz pay. Skinny Dip is an action-romantic-comedy-triangle about murder, vengeance, and the elusiveness of true accountability in this world.

name: One Attempt Remaining
summary: Years after their acrimonious divorce, an ex-couple learns that the cryptocurrency they won on a crazy night on a cruise is now worth millions… but they've forgotten the password. With only three days left before the account expires, they must retrace their steps that night, not just to find the password to their fortune, but also why they fell in love in the first place.

name: A Vow in the Dark
summary: Three hundred years ago, the Celestial Maiden Jin Li sealed away the Demon Lord Jie Chuan. Three centuries later, a young celestial beast, Jinli, accidentally breaks the seal. Drawn into the demon realm for her ability to absorb his magic, they are locked in a cycle of conflict and attraction. But when the truth emerges—that Jinli carries the fragmented soul of Celestial Maiden Jin Li—their fragile bond is tested by love, betrayal, and the echoes of an ancient feud.

name: Bird That Doesn't Cry
summary:
A Bird That Doesn't Cry is a melodrama centered on Oh Ha-nui, a woman whose life collapses after she becomes entangled in a high-stakes insurance murder case. What begins as a sudden family tragedy grows into a destructive chain of lies, greed, and betrayal.

As Ha-nui loses the stability and relationships she once relied on, she discovers that a woman named Chun Mi-ja stands at the heart of the events that ruined her life. Determined not to remain a victim, Ha-nui sets out to uncover the truth behind the crime and confront the people who exploited her pain for their own gain.

The story follows her journey through revenge, complicated loyalties, and the emotional cost of pursuing justice in a world where everyone has something to hide.

name: Noble Reincarnation: Born Blessed, So I'll Obtain Ultimate Power
summary: Noah, the world's strongest six-year-old, has been privileged enough to be reborn as the emperor's 13th child. What's more, he's been overpowered with an infinite level cap and a cheat that stacks the powers of anyone who serves him. But even privilege has its problems—the glittering facade of high society hides a world of conspiracies, schemes, and power struggles.

name: Come una madre
summary: Angela is a social worker, an active, empathetic woman with a sunny character. But a few months ago she lost her nine-year-old son Matteo in a car accident. A tragedy that broke her. In an attempt to rediscover the meaning of her existence, she returns to her family home, in a small village on an island in the Tuscan archipelago, where she was born. But even here the memories of her torment her.

name: Camaleón: El pasado no cambia
summary: Sabrina, an investigative journalist, leads a stable life with her daughter and husband. However, her world collapses with the reappearance of Salvador Carvallo, a famous artist and friend of her mother Iris, who reopens dark chapters in Sabrina's life that she thought were forgotten and threatens her stability.

name: Valiendo Madres
summary: Four young mothers strengthen their friendship beyond their children's school chat group after an intense school camping trip, where they discover who is having an affair with one of their husbands.

name: Äntligen!
summary: In five days the whole world will know that Jacob Widman is this year's Nobel price in economics. There's just one problem. He is dead. Jacob's best friends then decide to let those around them believe he's alive until the big day, but it soon turns out that each also has their own motives bubbling to the surface.

name: Treufoc
summary: This dark crime thriller follows Detective Aina Anglada as she begrudgingly works with her new partner, Damia, to find a serial killer before it's too late - following a grisly trail of body parts from the disturbed killer. Meanwhile, within their special police unit, trust is in short supply and the detectives, their commander, and others struggle to work together.

name: I Topi
summary: Antonio Albanese creates his first TV series for Rai, featuring Sebastiano, a mafia fugitive hiding in a villa in northern Italy, equipped with clever hiding spots. His existence, like that of real mafia fugitives, remains invisible to the police. Sebastiano relies on his trusted man U Stuortu, his wife Betta, daughter Carmen, who often clashes with him, and his son Benni, passionate about molecular cuisine. The family also includes his gambling aunt Vincenza and mafia boss uncle Vincenzo, who has been self-imprisoned in a basement for twelve years.

name: Pala sydämestä
summary: Drama about child welfare workers and the effects of their work on the lives of these workers. Rita returns to her job in child protection after being furloughed during a police investigation. The child is still missing, and Rita is held responsible for the situation. She was replaced as manager by a new director, Jyrki. When she returns to work, Rita is paired with the inexperienced Laura. Together, Rita and Laura become an effective team but the boundaries between their work and private life begin to blur.

name: Pressa
summary: An investigative journalist at a newspaper must save her uncertain career as she struggles with financial and personal issues.

name: Il Capitano Maria
summary: Maria returns to her hometown in Puglia hoping to spend more time with her teen daughter and young son. The family is immediately swept into conflicts between a criminal family (the Patriarcas) and "Neverland," led by mysterious Annagreca.

name: Das Begräbnis
summary: The occasion is sad, as Wolff-Dieter Meurer recently died. He was popular in the town of Lassahn in Mecklenburg-West Pomerania, in complete contrast to his wife Gaby Krolmann-Meurer. Now his four children have come to the funeral. While Sabine Stenz-Meurer, Thorsten, Mario and Kevin and other guests at the funeral talk about their father's memory, old stories soon surface that show the past in a new light. When inheritance disputes begin to boil over, devotion is over.

name: A Menina Sem Qualidades
summary: Ana is a 16 year-old, daughter of divorced parents, who are changing schools after being expelled from prior for attacking a colleague. His intelligence and his peculiar behavior to make be quite lonely.Until she meets Alex, a 18 year old who loves to test the social rules and question the world. Together, they decide to go beyond, to resolve play a joke on the teacher of Literature and Spanish, Tristán.

name: Чёрные кошки
summary: Bandit groups take over entire cities in post-war Russia. Rostov-on-Don is no exception. In 1947, a gang appears there that robs the city at night. Egor Dragun, a criminal investigation officer, suspects that the gang is not made up of ordinary criminals. As a result of the investigation, it turns out that the robbery of the city is just a cover. The main goal of the gang is to free a German scientist who is working on creating a nuclear bomb. Now Egor has to stop a new war.

name: 4 Mure
summary: A series of five episodes set in the same hotel room. Five different stories, five different genres and Marcelina, the charming yet incompetent hotel cleaner.

name: Drottningarna
summary: This unique documentary series sheds light on eight of Sweden's queens. Each episode is dedicated to one of our queens and her fascinating life story, from childhood to the last breath - always one step behind her king, but with great power to influence both politically and culturally. The series is based on real events from Swedish history from the 16th century until the 1930s that have never been told in a format like this before. The reconstructions take place at castles and manors around Sweden, including Stockholm Castle, Rosersberg Castle and Gripsholm Castle. Many times in the same place as the real event took place. In addition, environments have been created that will take place in Germany, France, Italy, Switzerland, Egypt, and the Netherlands.

previousepisode.name: The Queen Who Lived a Double Life

name: Cañas y Barro
summary: TV series that adapts the famous novel by Vicente Blasco Ibanez. In a village on the Albufera valenciana in an atmosphere of fishermen and rice, three generations of the family "the Dove" together in the place: the grandfather, the best fisherman on the lake, Hue, the son, who has devoted his life to gain ground water in an endless task, carrying earth to get his boat, inch by inch, to be able to cultivate a field, finally Tonet, the grandson, the black sheep of the family, which, by their conduct, cause disgrace of all. As a background of family life is the Spain of the late nineteenth and early twentieth century, an era full social transformation.

name: Madame Requin
summary: Madame Jacqueline Requin, widow, banker, economics expert, who presides over a financial group that makes up the bank she inherited from her husband, who recently died in a dubious accident. The bank is in imminent danger of bankruptcy. On a whirlwind eight-day trip to Buenos Aires, Jacqueline will try to carry out a mega political-financial scam that will allow her to obtain the funds to rescue her bank. This will generate a network of corruption that, as collateral damage, will irreparably harm her only emotional refuge: his daughter and granddaughter

name: Доченьки
summary: Vera Zhuravleva was an athlete and professionally engaged in wrestling. After a severe injury, her life changed dramatically. She got a job as a truck driver and moved in with her childhood friend Igor, whom she is going to marry without much love. An injury sustained during the competition made it impossible for her ever to become pregnant. In this regard, Igor's mother is unhappy with her son's choice. By coincidence, the widower Leonid, who has two children, appears in Vera's life. And the unexpected happens - unexpectedly, the youngest daughter of Leonid Marishka calls Vera her mother.

name: Тихие воды
summary: Former police psychiatrist Kira Ustyanova gets a job in an elite private clinic, which, in circumstances of the strictest secrecy, treats wealthy clients for neuroses and eating disorders. Two teenage girls are taken to the clinic - presumably after a suicide attempt. Their father, a wealthy businessman, died the day before under mysterious circumstances, their mother disappeared a few years before. The case is being handled by Kira's husband, who recently became an ex.

name: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
summary:
Inspired by his late mentor to explore life's big questions, Will throws himself into incredible challenges for 100 days: skiing to the South Pole, catching a giant anaconda, milking a venomous tarantula, climbing mountains, and diving under the ice of the North Pole. He will venture from pole to pole in the company of scientists, explorers and local experts.
 
Told with a cinematic scale, access, and authenticity only National Geographic can deliver, this once-in-a-lifetime adventure blends cutting-edge science, environmental storytelling, and bold exploration. Guided by experts, scientists and explorers, Will helps make world-first scientific discoveries and forges profound human connections — from the Amazon's Waorani community to the Kalahari's San people,whose knowledge and resilience offer powerful lessons about our future on the planet. Pole to Pole with Will Smith is an epic global undertaking defined by endurance, wonder and hope.

name: Tropang G.O.A.T.
summary: Three boys embark on a volleyball journey that will challenge far more than their athletic skills. As members of the "Green Goats," they must overcome formidable trials both on and off the court.

name: My Ilonggo Girl
summary:
Tata, a simple, poor and jolly Ilongga girl experiences a life-altering event when people realize she is the doppelganger of the rich and famous Venice, a social media influencer and actress from Iloilo.

When Venice escapes the country and abandons everything, her husband, Francis, will convince Tata to take her place while they look for her. However, Tata's impersonation of Venice soon takes a complicated turn when she falls in love with Francis and his family.

name: Widows' War
summary:
The story will revolve around the lives of best friends Sam and George, who treat each other as sisters, but later on, their friendship will be ruined and they will find love.

Unbeknownst to the two, they are marrying two men who belong to the same family, the Palacios.

previousepisode.name: An eye for an eye, a death for a death!

name: Bad Genius: The Series
summary: A top scholar uncovers how the school profits from students and fights back—turning cheat sheets into a money-making scheme.

name: Star Trek: Renegades
summary: Set a decade after the U.S.S Voyager's return to Earth, a rag-tag crew of renegades and outcasts must covertly work with Admiral Chekov and Tuvok to stop forces threatening the Federation from outside, and within.

name: Mozart/Mozart
summary: He is the superstar. She is "only" his sister, "Nannerl," even though she, like her brother, possesses exceptional musical talent. However, when Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart suffers a setback and can no longer perform, the family's financial future is suddenly at stake—and with it, Maria Anna's personal freedom. To save Amadeus's career and herself, Maria Anna is forced to step into her brother's shoes. Soon, she finds herself caught in a web of royal intrigue, at the center of which is none other than the man who has fallen head over heels in love with her: Antonio Salieri.

name: Road to the IndyCar Championship
summary: From Indy to Nashville, the fight for the championship heats up. Go behind the scenes for raw emotion, fierce battles, and every critical turn in America's premier open-wheel racing series.

name: It's Happening with Velshi & Ruhle
summary: MS NOW's Ali Velshi and Stephanie Ruhle answer your questions LIVE and take an in-depth look at the biggest stories at the intersection of business, politics and the economy.

name: Der Überfall
summary: A robbery attempt at a small corner store ends fatally. A seven-year-old boy disappears and an envelope with a lot of money changes hands. The lives of people who have never had anything to do with each other collide violently.

name: Ingen vej tilbage
summary: When friends with benefits, Nanna and Lasse, decide to take their relationship to the next level, Nanna quickly gets pregnant. But there is something, that Nanna hasn't told Lasse. Can their relationship survive those kinds of secrets?

name: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity
summary: Reiji Doki, an investigator for the Galaxy Federal Police, is Gavan Infinity, the only person in the universe permitted to claim the title of "Space Sheriff Gavan". However, he is stationed in the backwater Archives Department. His true objective is to investigate Emorgy crimes across dimensions.

name: My Special Tatay
summary:
In My Special Tatay, we will see the story of Boyet, a young man with a mild intellectual disability. His quiet and simple life with his single mom Isay will be disrupted when they find out that Boyet has a baby. Despite their status in life and Boyet's condition, they will take care of the child to the best of their ability. They will also be helped by his aunt Chona and his childhood friend / crush Carol.

Will they be able to meet the baby's needs? What kind of trials will their little family face? Will Boyet be able to fulfill his responsibility as a father despite his disability? Stay tuned for all that in My Special Tatay.

name: Avenues of the Diamond
summary: Sam is a friendly communications student who likes to party. Clyden is a snobby med student focused on studying. One day, these opposites suddenly find themselves arranged to be married. Will they escape their engagement or will this forced arrangement turn into real love?

name: Undercover Miss Hong
summary: Set against the backdrop of the 1990s, this retro office comedy follows Hong Geum Bo, a no-nonsense financial regulator in her 30s who lives for her work. But when suspicious activity surfaces at a major securities firm, her career takes an unexpected turn. Tasked with uncovering the truth, Geum Bo goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate, diving headfirst into an unfamiliar world of office politics, outdated tech, and hilarious culture clashes.

name: Asawa Ng Asawa Ko
summary:
Asawa Ng Asawa Ko tells the story of Cristy, Jordan and their daughter Tori. They're the epitome of a happy family, but things changed when Cristy was kidnapped by the armed group KALASAG. For four years, Cristy was held captive by KALASAG. Thinking that Cristy has died already, Jordan marries their friend Shaira, and she becomes the mother figure for Tori.

To everyone's shock, Cristy resurfaces and tries to reclaim her old life. Will she fight for the love of her life after all that she'd been through? Can she prove that love is worth fighting for now that her daughter has wholeheartedly accepted her stepmom? Can she get Jordan back from the arms of Shaira?

name: НАУЧРОК
summary: Hello, rockers! Alexander Pushnoy is with you! And today I have prepared a new format for you! NAUCHROK is a new show at the intersection of science and music. My guests and I dissect music and find out how much science there is in it. And of course, we test our theories with the help of Furry experiments! Yes, your favorite uhhh experiments! My friend, colleague, presenter of the Neskuchny Sound channel and songwriter Alexander Zilkov helps us with them. During our conversation, there are viewers in the audience who can ask us any questions. To do this, they only need to scan the QR code and write to our bot.

previousepisode.name: ИЗОБРЕТАЕМ НОВЫЙ ЗВУК | НАУЧРОК #2 | Вячеслав Дубынин

name: МИСТЕРИ ДЖЕРСИ
summary:
This is our new format where we unpack boxes of legendary players' jerseys and discuss their careers.
Everyone brings a jersey of some famous player that they would like to give to the others and puts it in a box. Then we blindly select one of the boxes and take the jersey we got. And of course, we are discussing the career of this player.

previousepisode.name: РАСПАКОВКА ДЖЕРСИ | ЧМ-26 | Адамян, Сапрыкин, Хох, Косицын | Мистери Джерси №9

name: СТЕНДАП-ТЕРАПИЯ
summary:
"Stand-up therapy" is a new show in which comedians speak out on really difficult topics that concern them, expanding the boundaries of the funny.

Here, audience laughter is therapy for the comedian, which helps them and the audience work through the traumatic moments of their lives.

How to survive a painful breakup or even the death of loved ones, what addiction is and how to cope with it, how to live with a serious illness and prolonged depression is about this and not only our show.

name: Го, я создал!
summary: We have created a computer game for Anton Shastun, in which the main character is Anton Shastun. 4 guests will play a platformer that we have developed especially for them, and at the end of the 4th edition we will find out the best gamer of the tournament!

name: CROWDWORK
summary:
Crowdwork is an improvisational show where four comedians compete to see which half of the audience is funnier and more active.

The fate of the battle is decided by judges chosen directly from the audience.

Whose half of the room turns out to be funnier, takes the stand on the bar.

name: The Lost Recipe
summary: The Lost Recipe is a fantasy romance series that revolves around love, time travel, and the culinary world. The series features Adobo, the most renowned Filipino dish in the world, together with other popular Filipino foods.

name: Είσαι το Ταίρι Μου
summary: Two Greek-Australian women - beautiful model Vicky and overweight Stella - switch identities during a flight to Greece. Vicky is meeting her fiancé's family, while Stella is meeting an online date.

name: Crime in Progress
summary: The story of each crime is woven together through raw, unfiltered video from the point of view of officer body cam and surveillance footage for a first-hand look at justice in action.

name: Love Me

name: Fadó Fadó
summary:
They don't make ads like they used to! They may only last a few seconds, but television adverts offer a unique and entertaining window into Irish life over the decades.

FADÓ FADÓ, takes us on a nostalgic trip down memory lane as different generations of family and friends come together to revisit the funniest, cheekiest, most unforgettable ads to ever grace Irish screens since television first arrived in homes in the 1960s.

From the swinging '60s to the disco-lit '70s, the sky-high hair of the '80s, and the Celtic Tiger–charged, grunge-tinged '90s, we look back at the ads that defined their eras. We discover how they still have the power to shock and delight, to make us laugh and cry—and how they reveal so much about Ireland and how we've evolved.

name: Hope Valley: 1874
summary: Rebecca Clarke travels from her home city of Chicago to the Western Canadian frontier with her 11-year-old-daughter. But when her wagon breaks down, she has no choice but to accept help from local rancher and confirmed bachelor, Tom Moore. Despite Rebecca's best intentions to remain unattached, the future she dreams of for her and her daughter along with the people she meets in this fledgling town – including the guarded Tom and tenacious pioneer woman Hattie Quinn – ultimately compel her to put down roots and make a fresh start.
